mainEntity.name: What's the difference between traditional SEO and AEO for beauty spas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO focuses primarily on keyword optimization, link building, and technical website improvements to rank higher in search engines. AEO, or AI-powered Everything Optimization, encompasses these elements but goes further by leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning. AEO analyzes vast amounts of data—from customer behavior to market trends—to predict optimal strategies, personalize content, automate tasks, and provide deeper insights for not just search ranking but also operational efficiency and client engagement. It's a more holistic and data-driven approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional SEO focuses on search rankings, while AEO uses AI to integrate SEO with broader data analysis for enhanced personalization, automation, and overall business optimization.
